jp_verse: ただ一本     静けさだけが     先に立つ
en_verse: one line remains       before the world decides       to multiply

jp_verse: 二つ置き     あいだに生まれる     やわらかな間
en_verse: not alone now       space starts speaking       between equals

jp_verse: 三つ並び     目にも心にも     落ちついて
en_verse: the third mark lands       and suddenly the air       feels arranged

jp_verse: 囲まれて     静かに残る     内の気配
en_verse: a frame appears       and what was open       learns to stay

jp_verse: まっすぐで     まっすぐでない     その強さ
en_verse: it almost balances       but keeps one hidden turn       to stay alive

jp_verse: 上に息     下へひらいて     形になる
en_verse: from the top       the thought breaks open       into room

jp_verse: ひとすじが     少し曲がって     意志になる
en_verse: one stroke turns       and suddenly feels       like intent

jp_verse: 左右へと     ひらいてゆけば     道になる
en_verse: the middle opens       and the world stops asking       for only one way

jp_verse: 曲がりつつ     ほどけず残る     強い先
en_verse: it leans forward       without falling out       of itself

jp_verse: 縦と横     出会ったところに     芯が立つ
en_verse: where lines cross       a quiet center       holds them both

jp_verse: 声の前     四角い静けさ     口を待つ
en_verse: before the word       there is an opening       waiting to speak

jp_verse: 日の中に     おさまる光     まだあたたかい
en_verse: day stands still       inside its simple walls       glowing quietly

jp_verse: 田の区切り     育つためには     道も要る
en_verse: the earth is split      so life can rise      with somewhere to go

jp_verse: 見つめれば     形の奥にも     気配あり
en_verse: the eye holds still      and more than the surface      comes forward

jp_verse: 古きもの     消えずに残る     声のよう
en_verse: old does not mean gone      it means the shape of time      still speaking

jp_verse: われここに     大きく言わず     ただ在りぬ
en_verse: I am not thunder      just a place from which      the world is answered

jp_verse: 見えぬまま     それでも一歩     出してみる
en_verse: risk is not noise      it is the quiet foot      that still goes on

jp_verse: 並び立つ     似た灯どうしの     あたたかさ
en_verse: side by side      not one shadow deeper      than the other

jp_verse: 日と月が     ともにあるとき     明るさ満つ
en_verse: brightness deepens      when light meets another light      and neither fades
